li.label: time for my dream
li.description: The council took me off the dull work so I can chase what matters to me. I'm not wasting a minute of it.

li.label: my dream can wait, apparently
li.description: I asked for a little help with the one thing I really want. The answer was: later. It's always later.

li.label: the council backed my dream
li.description: They put the colony's own silver behind what I want to do. Now I have to deserve it.

li.label: wasted the colony's silver
li.description: They trusted me with the colony's silver, and I handed it to a smiling trader for a crate of straw. I can't look at the purse.

li.label: learning from someone who knows
li.description: Every evening, questions and answers, and slowly the path starts to make sense. I should have asked years ago.

li.label: volunteered as a teacher
li.description: The council promised my evenings to someone else's dream. Nobody asked me first.

li.label: asked to teach
li.description: Somebody thinks I know things worth learning, and the council cleared my evenings so I can pass them on. Flattering.

li.label: my dream was called foolish
li.description: Someone said it out loud, in front of everyone: my dream is a joke. I keep hearing it.

li.label: a wager on my dream
li.description: There's a bet on me now. I'm going to win it, if only to see the look on their face.

li.label: an easy bet
li.description: I bet against a daydream. A week of free dinners, whenever reality catches up with it.

li.label: dreaming side by side
li.description: Two dreams, one workbench, and someone to talk it all over with at midnight. It's better this way.

li.label: not allowed to leave
li.description: I asked to go. They said no. The walls are the same walls, but they feel closer now.

li.label: asked to stay
li.description: They asked me to stay, and they meant it. Maybe the dream can grow here after all.

li.label: a friend almost left
li.description: Someone I care about nearly walked out with the next caravan. They're staying. I didn't know how worried I was until it was over.

li.label: the whole colony believes in me
li.description: Everyone at the table gave me a reason not to give up. I wrote them all down. I'm reading them again tonight.

li.label: pitied in front of everyone
li.description: They meant well. It still felt like my own funeral, with me sitting in the front row.

li.label: setting a dream down
li.description: There's no shame in letting it go, they said. They're right. It still aches where it used to be.

li.label: my dream will be remembered
li.description: Whatever happens to me, the colony knows what I was trying to do. It's written down now. That stays.

li.label: a dream written down
li.description: We all stood together while someone's dream was read out and written into the records. Strange, and a little beautiful.

li.label: carrying a promise
li.description: I promised to finish someone's dream if they can't. I meant every word. It weighs more than I expected.

li.label: told not to be morbid
li.description: I tried to talk about what happens if I don't make it. Everyone changed the subject. I'll stop bringing it up.
